title: Track Guide Summit Point - Jefferson BMW M2 CSR 51.1 iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Brake at the left wall, 90% pressure, trail brake to the top of the corner.
corners.line: Turn-in to the inside curb, apex close to the inside curb.
corners.exit: Accelerate smoothly, cut the first inside curb of turn two.
corners.mistakes: Overbraking and losing the inside curb.

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: Brake at the middle of the track, no more than 10% pressure.
corners.line: Cut the second curb, apex in the middle of the track.
corners.exit: Accelerate smoothly, stay close to the inside curb.
corners.mistakes: Going wider than the middle of the track.

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Brake just before the corner, 50% pressure, trail brake to the top of the corner.
corners.line: Stay close to the inside curb.
corners.mistakes: Going wider than the middle of the track.

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: Brake once losing the tree on the left, 80% pressure, trail brake to the inside curb.
corners.line: Stay as far to the right side of the track as possible.

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Break once you lose the tree on the left, 80% brake pressure, trail off to the inside curb.
corners.line: Stay close to the inside curb.
corners.exit: Slowly apply throttle, avoid grass to prevent spinning.
corners.mistakes: Hitting the traction control, going onto the grass.

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: Brake at the end of the curb on the right, 70% brake pressure, trail off to the top of the hill.
corners.line: Take a tighter line, get close to the inside curb.
corners.exit: Accelerate smoothly, aim for mid-track before turn seven.
corners.mistakes: Spinning the car, hitting the traction control.

corners.label: T7
corners.line: Aim for mid-track before turn seven.
corners.exit: Use all the room on the outside, accelerate smoothly.

general_tips: Stay as far right as possible in qualifying.
